prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Pearland, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1276; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative: On arrival at the intersection in Pearland, Texas, I observed two passenger vehicles with visible damage consistent with a side impact. Driver 1 was operating a sedan northbound and stated that the signal was green for their direction of travel. Driver 2 was operating an SUV westbound and stated that they entered the intersection after the light had changed to yellow. The front driver's side of Driver 2's vehicle made contact with the passenger side of Driver 1's sedan. Airbags deployed in Driver 1's vehicle. A Passenger seated in the rear of Driver 1's vehicle was assisted out and reported no injuries. Driver 1 reported pain in the left knee and was evaluated at the scene by EMS before being transported for further care. Both vehicles were towed from the roadway. Traffic control was established and the scene was cleared without further incident. Witness statements were requested but not obtained at the time of this report.
